card.fires_on: The word "annual" or "annually" (including the start of "annualized"), mostly before meeting, conference or rate terms.

modes.label: Annual meetings
modes.description: "annual" modifying a conference or meeting or a yearly publication.
modes.example: In June of 2011, an important advance in treating melanoma was announced at an<< annual>> cancer meeting.

modes.label: Annualized rates
modes.description: "annual" at the start of "annualized" before event or incidence rate in trial results.
